reviews.text: Charity took such great care of my 10-month-old Mini Goldendoodle! I really appreciated the care and attention she gave my puppy. It means so much to know your dog is in good hands. Thank you, Charity!

We’ve never used a mobile groomer before, but when we lost our groomer during the hottest summer we can recall, I contacted Raise the Wuff. Charity was professional, came early, was efficient & kind to our pup making her comfortable & back to her cute self. Thank you Charity!

Best groomer ever- she is kind, does a wonderful job (I have two giant breed and terrified dogs), was always on time and the dogs really liked her and let her trim their nails even (which not even our vet could without drugging the dogs).  100% recommend. And she comes to your house!!! So much easier!

Raise the Wuff Dog Wash is our go to dog wash because our dogs come out clean and fresh every single visit! They are patient, gentle, and take great care of all three of our dogs — especially our older guy, who needs a little extra attention. They always do a thorough job with bathing, ears, and nails, and our dogs come out looking and smelling great. They genuinely care about the animals they work with. Highly recommend Raise the Wuff to anyone looking for a reliable, caring dog grooming service!

Great experience for our two dogs.  Both dogs were washed and dried and one had a full cut and detailed trimming.  She was patient, took her time, made sure the dogs were relaxed and provided us with an iPad so that we can see this all happening in real time!  We will definitely be using Raise the Wuff again!

My dog is 12 years old and has never been to a groomer. Recently, I’ve been having trouble bathing him at home so after Reading reviews, we decided to book a mobile grooming appointment with Charity. She kept in great contact about the arrival time and was here right when she said she would be. Charlie was nervous at first, but she said him at ease and he was able to get through the whole appointment and he looks so handsome now! She did a fantastic job and we will definitely be back again.
I love the set up because Charity is very organized, easy to communicate with and provides a live video of the grooming process. I would recommend to all.
I highly recommend Raise the Woof!  Such a professional service and my sweet pup looks so wonderful and happy afterwards!  Have used them for a year and will keep using them!

I booked here last minute because my regular groomer canceled unexpectedly, and I’m glad I gave this place a chance. My husky was blowing out his coat badly and fur was everywhere in my apartment. The deshedding treatment helped more than I expected, and the groomer showed me just how much fur they removed during brushing. The whole process took longer than estimated, but with thick-coated dogs I understand why. He looked fluffy and comfortable afterward instead of tired or irritated.

Absolutely love Raise the Wuff Dog Grooming! My dog doesn't do well at groomers typically, we've had a couple bad experiences, and mobile grooming was our last ditch effort. I was amazed at how great my dog did after her first time with Raise the Wuff. Truly a wonderful experience and she always looks perfect and smells great after her grooming!

Logan rotates between baths and full grooming. We book appointments in advanced and keep on a routine.  Charity does a great job. Always shows up when she says she will, and Logan looks great! Thank you!
Charity was so sweet and so good to my babies! Definitely recommend her services.

I found Raise the Wuff while searching for a fear free dog groomer who is known for handling anxious dogs. I am so happy to have found them and lucky they had a cancellation for soon after I first contacted them. Charity was timely and very courteous and professional. My dog is a nervous girl usually with grooming but Charity made her feel safe and comfortable. Maple is not as nervous/shaky as she has been in the past coming home from the groomers and she looks great!
Very excited to have found them and will be calling them the next time she needs a groom!

Charity and Cali had a special connect!  Her timely arrival was always greeted by a woof and wagging tail! As Cali aged Charity often had to carry her to her bath!  What dedication and loving care! in fact, I,'ll miss Charity's care and concern for Cali but also her chat as she picked up Cali and then returned her to me me, all clean and happy! Charity is a true dog lover!
Charity was great! 100% recommend! Don’t wait until your dog is older. Start when they’re a pup so they get used to the pexperience. They’re in good hands with Charity.

So happy I found Charity at Raise the Wuff Mobile Dog Grooming!  She does an amazing job with our Labrador mix.  He has never looked better.  She is friendly, professional, on time, her mobile grooming is clean, which is a huge plus for me.  I would highly recommend her!!
Charity dos great work for my goldendoodle. Having her come to our house so my 13 yr old doodle doesn’t have to worry about waiting at a groomer all day. Effective and efficient.

She showed up on time.
Performed careful, clean and good work. She is also flexible and has friendly attitude!

Chastity is excellent! She is very responsive and ensures we keep on our grooming schedule. My dogs have completely different coats and she always cuts them perfectly! My little ladies love her and always are so soft and clean afterwards! My girls have never looked better!

Charity is amazing! She’s the best at communicating available appointments is always prepared, and very thorough. My dog is anxious- even the Vet can’t clip her nails. Charity can. Her calming presence makes my dog feel safe and comfortable. She’s worth the price. So glad I found her!

My dog Rocket came out looking fabulous. More importantly, he didn’t have a scary experience . He’s a dog with trainer diagnosed PTSD. This was his first time being professionally groomed so I was anxious. You treated him so well. He wasn’t afraid of you at all.
I like the trailer set up. It was so clean inside.
Thank you for your expert care and kindness.

Raise the Wuff is AMAZING! 10/10 would recommend. Our dog has always struggled at traditional grooming salons with fear of the air dryer. Charity was incredible and helped her calmly get dry and groomed (and beautifully so!). We’re now customers for life.
Kind, timely, responsive, and takes great care of my dog! She smells great, and looks so cute after her haircut!

Charity is a great dog groomer.  I have a difficult and stubborn dog, and Charity is great working with her.  Charity is always organized and timely for all of her appointments. If you want a responsible and capable dog groomer, you can’t do better than Charity!

We love Raise The Wuff! My dog hated going to groomers in the past but now will hop right up onto the grooming table every time without hesitation, ready for her new haircut. They do an amazing job, highly recommend!

Charity is amazing! She is so good with our anxious fur baby. He loves her. ❤️ He looks so adorable when she is done, it’s not easy cuz he is part poodle and his hair is fine and yet goes all directions.

Charity did a great job with my dog. She HATES baths, was well behaved and had her nails clipped and ears cleaned. She was wagging her tail a mile a minute. Thank you Raise the Wuff Mobile Dog Grooming. I'd  give them 10 stars!!

My boy is a fairly anxious dog, but did great with Raise the Woof! He seemed to be fairly at ease vs with typical grooming salons. Very patient and attentive to him. You can check in and watch throughout the grooming also which I appreciate.
Charity did a great job with my Golden Retriever. I’d highly recommend them for a dog groomer.

Highly recommend this company and owner.  My dog is a shepard and elderly. She has been receiving spa days with care and gentle attention.  I fully trust this service.  It does not seem rushed and my dog is not stressed or anxious after. She usually gets her nails clipped and a de shedding bath. She smells so good after without the artificial fragrances that could make her sick.  Make sure you call this service.  Charity is the best.

Raise the Wuff is so great! My senior dog had gotten grumpy and difficult whenever I brought him to a groomer, so I decided to try mobile grooming to see if he would be less stressed. She's great and he is much more relaxed when I hand him over. He always comes out great. I'm relieve to find such a great Mobile groomer that makes the process much easier for my dog and me!

Charity has been doing the grooming for our German shepherd mix for about a year and always does a really good job. Shes great with our dog, Nova, and is always timely and communicative. Highly recommend!

This has been the best dog grooming company we’ve used for our corgi puppy! After going to two other groomers we were disappointed by their lack of communication and harsh scented shampoos, but our experience with Charity has been the complete opposite. She’s punctual, very communicative, and does an amazing job - his little corgi booty has never looked better since bringing him to her 🍑 the mobile option is beyond convenient for our busy schedules, will definitely continue to use this service!

One of our dogs is a rescue with a lot of anxiety. He is afraid of everything. We usually take him to the vet for nail trimming, but it causes him a lot of stress to go to the vet. Accordingly, we decided to try Raise The Wuff to see if mobile grooming was easier on our pup. We are so glad that we did!

Both our dogs look and smell great. Thank you!
Highly recommend! I’m a busy working professional and it’s so helpful to have fast and convenient service without sacrificing quality. My dog always comes back looking great and is happy.

I had the pleasure of using Raise the Wuff for Nora’s first mobile grooming experience, and they did not disappoint! Charity was an absolute delight to work with. From the moment we first spoke, she kept me informed every step of the way. She explained exactly what would happen during the appointment and made sure Nora was comfortable the entire time. It was clear that she truly cares about the pets she works with. I highly recommend Raise the Wuff and will definitely be booking again for future grooming needs!
Charity was punctual and thorough with grooming our small dog! I recommend and will use her services again!

I cannot say enough good things about Raise the Wuff! Charity is the best groomer! We have a Portugese Water Dog puppy with curly hair and he always looks so handsome after each bath and grooming. He is a high energy dog and I wasn’t sure if he would like to be groomed. But as soon as Charity showed us her trailer and explained her process, it was clear he was in good hands. She came highly recommended to us and I see why. I won’t take my dog anywhere else!
Great experience! On time, communication was clear & the haircut for my dog was exactly what I asked for!

I can't recommend Charity enough! My doodle always looks absolutely stunning after every visit.
Charity is incredibly skilled and attentive, and I always get compliments on how amazing my baby looks. She truly takes her time to make sure everything is perfect, and it shows! The level of care and detail is unmatched. If you want your pup to look their absolute best, this is the place to go!
Charity is awesome! I've used her for my dog since she was a puppy. Charity is responsive, and her services are excellent!

I am so grateful to have found Charity and Raise the Wuff! We have used several other mobile services, but our small dogs have anxiety issues and sadly suffered a few bumps and scrapes after their grooming sessions. In my search, I found Raise the Wuff, and we are relieved to have done so.  My older dog has anxiety issues and arthritis, and my little guy is a bit skittish. Charity has a true love for animals, which was demonstrated by her communication with us before our appointment and how she puts both boys at ease. She also gave us an iPad to watch both grooming appointments--the best-added perk! We found many times during the appointment that the boys were content and being cared for during their appointments. Both dogs looked happy and handsome after their grooming session. Thank you so much, Raise the Wuff...we are looking forward to our next appointment!

Charity from Raise the Wuff is fantastic. We have a senior dog and and she is incredible with him. We needed someone who could manage and groom an aging dog and we were so lucky to find her. She is wonderful with your pet, a talented groomer and extremely professional. If you are thinking about this service let me save you trouble and tell you to book it. It is worth the money. Before Raise the Wuff our dog would freak out for grooming appointments and he goes happily with a wagging tail everytime  with Charity.

I recently had the pleasure of using Raise the Wuff mobile dog grooming service for my first time, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From start to finish, everything was incredibly convenient and professional. …

I’ve been having Charity come groom my very hairy German Shepherd for over a year now and I will never go to another groomer again as long as I’m in San Diego & she’s still in business! She takes her time and is so thorough. My pup always …

Charity is such a wonderful, professional, and kind dog groomer! She is very punctual, quick, and takes such good care of my puppy, who is very nervous while getting groomed typically. She always leaves my puppy fresh, and clean, and with …
Outstanding job! Very flexible with times and dates. Great customer service!  100% recommend using Raise The Wuff!

We have had a wonderful experience with Raise The Wuff! Our pup is older with some health issues and going to the groomer became too much for her. Raise the Wuff has been wonderful, excellent communication and she always takes such good care of our girl, mindful and patient with her limitations from her arthritis. Highly recommend.

I can't say enough good things about Charity! She has been absolutely wonderful with our older dog, Max, who hasn't had much grooming experience in the past. From the moment we started coming to her, she has treated Max with so much …
Great service and Charity is wonderful with my two boxers.  Highly recommend Raise the Wuff!!!
